title: Grouped runs generate duplicate traces when run dates differ
reasoning: The iteration table deduplicates complete metadata tuples, including run_date, but the loop selects data only by display_name. Grouped repetitions sharing a display name and having different dates therefore render the same combined data repeatedly. This duplicates legends and traces, including identical grouped bars and checkpoint means.
reproduction: Use two runs with the same display_name, different run_date values, and group_runs enabled. Each affected builder iterates that display name twice and renders its combined data twice.
recommendation: Sort the metadata and then deduplicate by the actual trace identity, display_name, before rendering grouped data.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied tests cover isolated heatmap values and scatter configuration; none exercises repeated runs in these builders. test_pass.py contains production chart code, not tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise grouped repetitions with varying dates and assert one trace per display name per metric, with statistics calculated from every repetition exactly once.
minimumFixScope: Trace iteration in comparison.py, boxplot.py, and test_pass.py.
